relations.subject: Sir Henry Miers Elliot
relations.evidence: Sir Henry Miers Elliot (1 March 1808 – 20 December 1853) was an English civil servant and historian who worked with the East India Company in India for 26 years.

relations.subject: Sir Henry Miers Elliot
relations.evidence: His historical researches bore fruit in The History of India, as Told by Its Own Historians. The Muhammadan Period, edited by John Dowson, 8 vols. 1866–1877
